correctness.rationale: The expansion of eight times the exact triple-pattern witness count correctly subtracts all three base-vertex terms, uses linear character sums zero and separable quadratic character sums minus one, and applies the elliptic-curve Hasse bound |T| <= 2 sqrt(q). The resultant inequality 8N >= q-15-2 sqrt(q) gives N >= 3 for all eligible q >= 49. Two independent fully executed integer programs verify (i) all triple/pattern counts and complete pair coverage for q=29,37,41 and (ii) the six explicit adjacent/nonadjacent orbit representatives with exact witness sets. Square-scaling affine automorphisms cover every pair, proving universal failure after a two-vertex deletion at the three exceptional orders. The four-variable three-extension sentence and permanent four-pebble strategy give the claimed logical equivalence, without any quantifier-depth bound.

originality.rationale: The precise claim is a sharp universal pair-deletion phase transition across every eligible Paley order at least 29, together with its FO^4 implication, rather than the classical Paley 3-extension theorem. Inspected primary results establish older 3-e.c. facts, general sufficiently-large witness multiplicity, or one-vertex deletion at order 29 but did not state the conjunction of every-pair fragility at 29,37,41 and every-pair robustness at all orders at least 49. Inaccessible full text of Ananchuen--Caccetta (1993) leaves residual historical-priority risk; its abstract does not decide exact coverage.
residual_risks: Full 1993 Ananchuen--Caccetta paper unavailable; its quantitative P(m,n,k) theorems might imply some or all q>=49 witnesses.

value.rationale: The exact minimum number of extension witnesses is a natural resilience invariant and determines preservation of a full unbounded-depth four-variable logical theory. The theorem gives a sharp uniform phase transition, proves all-pair fragility rather than merely an existence counterexample at three exceptional orders, and explains it through automorphism pair-orbits and a clean elliptic-curve character bound. This provides substantive structural information rather than a parameter renaming or a routine table.
